name: traceability-matrix
description: Create a requirements traceability matrix linking requirements to design, test, and delivery. Use when the user says "traceability matrix", "RTM", "requirements traceability", "link requirements to tests", "trace requirements", "coverage matrix", "are all requirements tested", "requirements coverage", "forward traceability", "backward traceability" - even if they don't explicitly say "traceability matrix".
